purpose: Refine and validate the three-regime bridge at low kappa, centered on the candidate_SS3 corridor identified by sim6. Primary goal: determine whether the mixed interface-bearing state at kappa=0.05 is transient SS2 approach or true sustained SS3-class persistence.

empirical_basis.summary: sim6 resolved a three-regime bridge at low kappa, strongest at kappa=0.05: runaway -> candidate_SS3 -> SS2. The bridge is IC-structured, with IC0 showing the strongest sustained mixed/interface state at final time.
source_notes: Bridge-region interpretation from sim6 agent report and available summaries.

core_hypothesis.H1: At kappa=0.05 there exists a finite lambda interval in which IC0 sustains a mixed interface-bearing regime with exclusion_fraction in (0,1), rho > 0, and interface_count > 0 at long horizon.
core_hypothesis.H2: This interval is the strongest current candidate for SS3-class continuation.
core_hypothesis.H3: IC dependence near the bridge is genuine pathway sensitivity, not numerical noise.

primary_slice.rationale: Covers the strongest observed bridge corridor and the mixed/interface-bearing IC0 states reported by sim6.

phase_plan.description: Dense lambda refinement at kappa=0.05 using current production settings plus longer horizon.
phase_plan.expected_outcome: Locate the corridor edges and identify which lambda values keep IC0 in mixed/interface-bearing continuation at final time.

moderate: appears in more than one seed

promote_to_SS3_candidate: final_interface_count >= 1 in at least 50% of seeds for IC0
no monotone drift of all runs into SS2 by end of horizon
reject_as_transient_to_SS2: interface_count falls to 0 in nearly all seeds before end
final_exclusion_fraction trends toward 0 across longer horizon
final_mean_rho converges tightly to SS2 plateau

minimal_success_condition.statement: At least one lambda value near kappa=0.05 yields IC0 runs with mixed final state and surviving interface at T_max=1000.
minimal_success_condition.meaning: Bridge corridor is real and not merely a short transient.

strong_success_condition.statement: A contiguous lambda sub-band near kappa=0.05 sustains mixed interface-bearing continuation for IC0 across multiple seeds and survives Nx increase.

notes.interpretation: This sim7 program is not a broad exploratory scan. It is a targeted validation/refinement campaign centered on the first resolved bridge region.
notes.risk: The corridor may shrink with longer horizon and resolve into SS2. That would still be a meaningful result because it would tightly locate the bridge geometry.
notes.priority_message: Do not spend compute expanding unrelated regions until the kappa=0.05 corridor is resolved.
